comment: Classification of differences between TinyCat 4.5.6 and Spire Ledger. Each rule names explicit TinyCat tables and fields, a direction condition, and a quote that must appear verbatim in the cited document. First matching rule wins. Category a = registered metric decision (metrics.md), b = registered defect.
